sources.label: Morphe patches to bring BaconReader back to love
sources.author: JoanComasFdz BaconReader
patch_list: Disables the "Please take a few moments to provide feedback about BaconReader" popup.
Disables the "FINAL RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!" popup that says goodbye when the app starts.
Disables "View Sidebar" on Front Page, All, Popular, Friends and multireddits, which have no sidebar.

Adds options to show GIFs, image links, Imgur albums and emotes in comments and posts as images, play videos uploaded in comments and video links, show bare YouTube links with the video title and thumbnail, and show bare X and Bluesky link…
Fixes saving media to the device also creating an empty file.
Fixes Imgur albums and galleries not loading, and image uploads in comments and posts failing.
Fixes empty thumbnails in the post list, shows a preview as thumbnail for link posts and crossposted galleries, and blurs the thumbnails of NSFW and spoiler posts.
Fixes votes on a post disappearing from the post list when made while its comments load.
Fixes the meme templates of the drawing screen not loading, with Imgflip's most used templates.
Fixes Redgifs media not loading by using temporary Redgifs API tokens.
Turns the orange inbox envelope back to normal when the last unread message is marked as read, and removes "Mark unread", which Reddit no longer supports.
Adds a "Flair" button to the sort bar of subreddits, to show only the posts with the chosen flairs.
Hides spoilers (>!...!<) that contain formatting, links or code behind the spoiler box, instead of showing them in plain sight.

Shows a still preview with a progress bar and the downloaded size while post media and gallery images load, uses small previews for the thumbnails of galleries, shows a message instead of a broken page when a RedGIFs video was deleted, and…
Opens the comment reply screen, with the replied comment or message, when replying from the inbox, instead of the plain "Send message" form.
Adds options to load up to 500 comments when opening a post instead of about 200, and to load the "load more comments" with few replies automatically.
Makes the text box of comments, replies, edits, messages and text posts as big as possible, adds a bar with Reddit's formats and a character counter above it, and shows the formatting while typing.
Android does not allow the app to open Reddit links by itself. Asks once to set them up, and adds an option to open the "Open by default" screen.

Adds Chat to the menu, next to the Inbox, which shows Reddit's chat from its mobile website on the main screen. The chat messages Reddit also sends to the inbox are counted next to Chat and notified as chat messages instead.
Removes the award icons, "Give Award" and "View Award Details". Reddit's API no longer reports awards, and giving them used Reddit's discontinued coins.
Removes Random and My Random from the feed list. Reddit removed r/random and r/myrandom in December 2024, so they never load.
Adds the sound to Reddit videos saved with "Save to device", which were saved without it.
Adds a search button to the sort bar of posts, to find, highlight and jump between the comments with a text or user name, or show only those comments.
Shows the actual error when a Reddit request fails, instead of the message saying that BaconReader stopped working in July 2023.
Shows tables in comments and posts as a grid instead of "header: value" lines. Wide tables can be expanded and scrolled sideways, and links in tables can be tapped.
Adds an option to show the author's avatar before the name in comments, as on Reddit's website.
Makes logging in to Reddit work again by using another Reddit app's client ID.
Replaces the expand button of text posts in the post list, which looks like a video play button, with a page icon and a chevron that flips when the text is expanded.
Adds a setting to stop videos, such as v.redd.it videos, from loading and playing by themselves in a post's detail view: the post shows its preview image, and a tap on it plays the video.
